freeze_rule: On first ingestion of a post-lock public release, compute probabilities from strictly earlier completed release events and persist them immutably before outcome scoring.
evaluation_rule: Score only immutable frozen predictions for release events whose public actual release timestamp is strictly after locked_at. Never recompute model probabilities for scoring.
promotion_rule: No automatic promotion. A new policy epoch must be created explicitly after reviewing genuinely out-of-sample results.
note: Epoch 2 begins the frozen-prediction-ledger OOS protocol. Epoch 1 is archived and remains historical provenance only.
